de: The capital of the crusader County of Edessa falls to Imad ad-Din Zengi, the atabeg of Mosul and Aleppo.

t: 乔哈尔手下的法蒂米德人在开罗城门击败了卡尔马提亚人,结束了第一次卡尔马提亚人入侵埃及.
te: The Fatimids under Jawhar defeat the Qarmatians at the gates of Cairo, putting an end to the First Qarmatian invasion o…
dz: 艾恩·沙姆斯之战:乔哈尔手下的法蒂米德人在开罗城门击败了卡尔马提亚人,结束了第一次卡尔马提亚人入侵埃及.
de: Battle of Ayn Shams: The Fatimids under Jawhar defeat the Qarmatians at the gates of Cairo, putting an end to the First Qarmatian invasion of Egypt.

t: 唐代诗人杜甫启程前往成都，受到诗人裴迪的接待。
te: Tang dynasty poet Du Fu departs for Chengdu, where he is hosted by fellow poet Pei Di.
dz: 唐代诗人杜甫启程前往成都，受到诗人裴迪的接待。
de: Tang dynasty poet Du Fu departs for Chengdu, where he is hosted by fellow poet Pei Di.

t: 教宗约翰四世在前任去世后几个月当选.
te: Pope John IV is elected, several months after his predecessor's death.
dz: 教宗约翰四世在前任去世后几个月当选.
de: Pope John IV is elected, several months after his predecessor's death.

t: 中国皇帝萧燕将萧通取名为"他继承人".
te: Chinese emperor Xiao Yan names Xiao Tong his heir designate.
dz: 中国皇帝萧燕将萧通取名为"他继承人".
de: Chinese emperor Xiao Yan names Xiao Tong his heir designate.
